compatibility_specification: observable OCaml behavior for the pinned HOL Light/Flyspeck subset

import_contract.entry_identity: The authoritative source ledger owns its entry bodies and IDs; this project index records only immutable source coordinates, digests, field mappings, and entry IDs.
import_contract.duplicate_policy: reject duplicate IDs across local and imported ledgers
import_contract.update_policy: advance an import only by changing its git commit, artifact digest, declared entry IDs, and any schema-adapter notes in one reviewed commit
import_contract.projection_policy: source-native fields remain authoritative; field_map documents the lossless v1.3 projection and schema_gaps documents work still needed at the source

schema_gaps: The source ledger has a regression requirement but not yet one or more stable regression IDs.
Remedy and proof-obligation lifecycle statuses are not yet separate source fields.
Affected targets/locations are source strings rather than repository-qualified location objects.

related_artifacts.relationship: Authoritative Candle-native target inventory; compatibility findings link to its stable target names rather than cloning the manifest.

entries.summary: Determine the accepted declaration-open and module-path subset from pinned source occurrences
entries.notes: An inventory hit is not itself an incompatibility. Confirm behavior with minimized OCaml/Candle tests before changing divergence_state.

entries.summary: Decide support or normalization policy for let-open and parenthesized local-open syntax
entries.notes: Repository-snapshot presence does not prove production dependency-closure membership.

entries.summary: Classify required include, alias, functor, module-type, and first-class-module behavior
entries.notes: Syntactic forms are machine-classified; module semantics and actual load reachability remain unclassified.

entries.summary: Candle cannot express OCaml physical equality/inequality at the 12 selected non-reference call sites

ocaml_reference.outcome: OCaml 4.14.1 accepts and passes both non-reference list == and list != identity oracles

candle_outcome.outcome: list == is rejected because Candle types == as reference-only; list != reaches an unsupported relational-operator parser path
evidence: timeout 20s /project/repos/candle/candle.sh < compatibility/oracles/pointer_identity_list.ml => Type mismatch between _0 ref -> _0 ref -> bool and int list -> _1 at line 2
timeout 20s /project/repos/candle/candle.sh < compatibility/oracles/pointer_identity_inequality.ml => Impossible: nRelOp; Parsing failed at line 2

proof_obligation.description: Give the selected Candle subset a verified physical-identity observation matching OCaml, or justify a source transformation for every call site and prove preservation of structural results, identity-visible results, termination, and allocation-sensitive control flow.

entries.notes: Ten sites intentionally control structural reuse. Two identity-filter sites have medium-confidence high-level intent and therefore may not be silently rewritten to structural inequality. The == and != failures are both live syntax/type incompatibilities even though source dependency alone does not prove every call is dynamically evaluated.

entries.summary: Candle rejects the selected OCaml immediate-int n == 1 LP verifier branch

ocaml_reference.outcome: OCaml 4.14.1 accepts the n == 1 shape and evaluates it true

candle_outcome.outcome: type failure: Candle's == expects references, not ints
evidence: timeout 20s /project/repos/candle/candle.sh < compatibility/oracles/pointer_identity_immediate.ml => Type mismatch between _0 ref -> _0 ref -> bool and int -> _1 at line 2

proof_obligation.description: Show the Candle meaning of the selected == expression agrees with OCaml 4.14.1 for every count_terminals int value, independently of heap representation, or normalize it to value equality and prove the branch is unchanged.

entries.notes: This is an integer value test expressed with OCaml physical equality, not evidence that the proof code intends allocated-object identity.

entries.summary: Resolve the selected local (==) binding to theorem-producing eq_eq rather than pointer identity

ocaml_reference.outcome: OCaml 4.14.1 resolves the local (==) and produces true

candle_outcome.outcome: Candle resolves the local (==) and binds pointer_identity_shadowing_oracle_ok = true

proof_obligation.description: Prove Candle name resolution assigns the infix use to the simultaneous local binding eq_eq with its theorem type and does not lower it as built-in physical equality.

entries.notes: Both the operator-definition token and its use are required source dependencies, but neither is a pointer-identity operation after source-backed local name resolution.

entries.summary: Specify and verify the startup chdir customFFI contract and platform boundary

candle_outcome.outcome: The selected Candle binary reaches its REPL, so the boot-image chdir success path returned zero
evidence: timeout 45s /project/repos/candle/candle.sh < compatibility/oracles/custom_ffi_system.ml reached the REPL and loaded hol_loader.ml

chosen_remedy.description: Retain only with total validation, deterministic errors, regression coverage, and an explicit platform refinement/trust statement.

proof_obligation.description: Prove byte/NUL/result encoding, total failure behavior, exact boot-root transition, and the trusted relationship of the patched C glue and host chdir syscall to the CakeML call.

entries.notes: Required runtime call: build-instructions.sh appends this source to candle_boot.ml and the file invokes chdir immediately. Current C assertions and implicit C-string assumptions are not a discharged contract.

entries.summary: Specify, constrain, and verify the Sys.command customFFI shell bridge used by full Flyspeck LP certificate loading

candle_outcome.outcome: The current success path returns the normal child exit status 7

chosen_remedy.description: Retain only with a narrow selected-workflow command policy, total validation, deterministic errors, sandbox regressions, and a platform trust statement; prefer removing shell interpretation where practical.

proof_obligation.description: Prove command/result equivalence for required OCaml observations; define allowed commands, PATH/environment/filesystem effects and sandbox; handle malformed and signalled processes totally; account for C glue, shell, tar, and rm in trust.

entries.notes: Required runtime call: the full sequence verifies the tracked hard_7.tar.gz certificate, whose reader invokes Sys.command to run tar and rm. This is a high-risk open platform item, not a confirmed language divergence.
